supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Extends beyond the outer ocular margins, tapering slightly toward the lateral facial boundaries.

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the dark-pigmented cheek and periocular regions and the significantly lighter (grey/white) muzzle and chin area.

maxillary_and_labial_geometry.resting_lip_thickness: Moderate vertical thickness of the lower lip with a straight, horizontal resting profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive white hair growth across the mental and lower labial regions, forming a distinct beard-like patch.
